answer: Agents secure entry by performing 1,000 unique data-repair tasks, a cost honest agents pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A verifier monitors the willow-like memory structure for state overlap, rejecting any log that fails to provide ivory-clear execution proof. If a ridge of redundant operations emerges during audit, the system flags sybil evidence and burns the identity, assuming unique data tasks are non-poolable.
